import sys
import math
from collections import defaultdict

def power(a, n, mod, ans=1):
    while n:
        if n & 1:
            ans = (ans * a) % mod
        a = (a * a) % mod
        n >>= 1
    return ans

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    mod = 10**9 + 7

    r100 = power(100, mod - 2, mod)
    p = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    index = 1
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            p[i][j] = int(data[index])
            index += 1
            p[i][j] = (p[i][j] * r100) % mod

    pro = [[1]*(1 << n) for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(1 << n):
            prod = 1
            for k in range(n):
                if (j >> k) & 1:
                    prod = (prod * p[i][k]) % mod
                else:
                    prod = (prod * (mod + 1 - p[i][k])) % mod
            pro[i][j] = prod

    bpt = [0]*(1 << n)
    vec = [[] for _ in range(n+1)]
    id_list = [0]*(1 << n)
    for i in range(1 << n):
        bpt[i] = bin(i).count('1')
    for i in range(1 << n):
        vec[bpt[i]].append(i)
        id_list[i] = len(vec[bpt[i]]) - 1

    q = [[0]*(1 << n) for _ in range(1 << n)]
    for i in range(1 << n):
        for j in range(n):
            if not ((i >> j) & 1):
                q[i][1 << j] = 1 << id_list[i | (1 << j)]
        for j in range(1 << n):
            q[i][j] = q[i][j & -j] | q[i][j ^ (j & -j)]

    memo = {}
    def calc(now, st):
        if st == 0:
            return 0
        if now == n:
            return 1
        if (now, st) in memo:
            return memo[(now, st)]
        ans = 0
        j = 1
        while j < (1 << n):
            nst = 0
            for k in range(len(vec[now])):
                if not (st & (1 << k)):
                    continue
                cur = vec[now][k]
                nxt = j - (j & cur)
                nst |= q[cur][nxt]
            ans += (pro[now][j] * calc(now + 1, nst)) % mod
            j += j & -j
        memo[(now, st)] = ans % mod
        return memo[(now, st)]

    print(calc(0, 1))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
